POC technical notes / asks:

- Fallback routing policy: pin -> compatible quantized model in same region -> burst to hosted fallback (only for non-sensitive projects).
- Audit log requirements: immutable append-only logs with export to Splunk and S3 with signed timestamps. Retention policy configurable per project.
- Networking: customer requires Dedicated in VPC with private peering; possibility to host code-search index on-prem and only send embeddings via secure link.

- Operations: rollout controls (canary), automated fallback, and clear support SLAs.
